metadata.description: CEH Claude Code plugins for the full software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: ceh-core
plugins.description: CEH core: standards that hold however Claude Code is used — usage-limit handoff and context economy via delegated bulk reads.

plugins.name: ceh-coding-agent
plugins.description: CEH coding-agent standards: the behavior contract and five-step workflow, write-less-code minimalism, retroactive refactoring, whole-repo explanation, and the living architecture document.

plugins.name: ceh-git-workflow
plugins.description: CEH Git workflow: branching, commits, pull requests from open to merge (with definition-of-done gate), changelog entries, README upkeep, releases including hotfixes, and code review. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: ceh-testing
plugins.description: CEH testing techniques: stack-agnostic test design and verification moments — reproduce a bug before fixing it, choose test inputs systematically, audit whether a green suite is trustworthy, prove a refactor preserved behavior, and close the risk gaps functional tests structurally miss.

plugins.name: ceh-python-service
plugins.description: CEH Python service: FastAPI, asyncpg, PostgreSQL schema, Alembic migrations, uv, testing (unit/integration/system), observability, security, and domain modeling standards for web services.

plugins.name: ceh-python-library
plugins.description: CEH Python library: packaging and publishing, public API surface discipline, semantic versioning, uv environment, and pytest testing standards for distributable libraries (no web dependencies).

plugins.name: ceh-web-frontend
plugins.description: CEH web frontend: SvelteKit and React (Vite) conventions, Bun, TypeScript style, ESLint/Prettier, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, accessibility, UI visual design and theming, Cytoscape.js graph visualization, and testing agents (unit/integration/system).

plugins.name: ceh-seo
plugins.description: CEH SEO: discoverability standards for anything exposed to the internet — technical SEO/GEO for public web pages (meta tags, structured data, sitemap, rendering strategy), authoring the llms.txt agent index, and findability of public-facing text (README first screen, package descriptions and keywords, repo topics, landing copy).

plugins.name: ceh-blog
plugins.description: CEH blog: turn a half-formed idea into a compelling, publishable blog post in a personal, series-first voice via structured interview; repurpose finished posts for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TL;DR, and newsletters.

plugins.name: ceh-plan-build-review
plugins.description: CEH plan-build-review: the plan-driven development loop — plan a fullstack app (iteratively or all the way to MVP), implement from the plan, review the implementation against it, and patch a shipped version with small non-feature changes.

plugins.name: ceh-documentation
plugins.description: CEH documentation: write user-facing documentation for a project — a full docs set, user guides and operator runbooks, an exhaustive API reference, concept pages with sourced design rationale, and runnable examples.

plugins.name: ceh-ag-ui
plugins.description: CEH AG-UI: generative-UI canvases for agents that speak the AG-UI protocol — a React + Vite canvas where the agent places components from a fixed, themed catalogue (Tidewater by default), adding catalogue components, a Claude-backed FastAPI agent server, live shared state, and human approval steps.

plugins.name: ceh-usability-audit
plugins.description: CEH usability audit: measure whether a non-expert can actually use what you built — cold zero-context walkthroughs by persona-constrained subagents that report where they stalled and how many steps each milestone cost against a budget set before the walk, a five-question interface audit across web UI/CLI/library/app surfaces, a three-part rewrite pass over every user-reachable error message, and a plain-language pass over labels and copy. Findings are ranked by observed outcome, not by how bad they look.

plugins.name: ceh-business-plan
plugins.description: CEH business plan: turn a product idea or an existing app plan into a validated business plan via a rigorous product-market-fit interview loop — draft, interrogate the weakest assumption, revise, repeat until a PMF readiness gate passes.

plugins.name: ceh-git-datastore
plugins.description: CEH git-backed datastore: run an app on a bare git repo instead of a database while that still fits — a gate that talks you out of it when it does not, a working plumbing-only store, and the pinned-snapshot migration to Postgres or SQLite when a trigger fires.

plugins.name: ceh-workflow-builder
plugins.description: CEH workflow builder: interview a repetitive multi-step task into a runnable artifact — one skill when it is simple, or a gated workflow skill that delegates each step and declares its handoff schemas — emitted into the target repo's .claude/skills/.

plugins.name: ceh-scenario-service
plugins.description: CEH scenario bundle: working on a Python backend service — features, fixes, tests, docs, releases.

plugins.name: ceh-scenario-library
plugins.description: CEH scenario bundle: working on a Python library — features, fixes, tests, docs, releases.

plugins.name: ceh-scenario-webapp
plugins.description: CEH scenario bundle: working on a web frontend — features, fixes, tests, docs, releases.

plugins.name: ceh-scenario-ideation
plugins.description: CEH scenario bundle: shaping an idea before a stack is chosen — testing it for product-market fit and planning the build.

plugins.name: ceh-scenario-editorial
plugins.description: CEH scenario bundle: writing and publishing what readers see — blog posts, user and operator docs, discoverability.
